initial_outreach.subject: Quick question for {company}
initial_outreach.body:
Hi {name},

I was looking into {company}, and it seems like {pain_hook} might be causing some missed opportunities.

A lot of teams do not really have a lead problem — they have a response time problem.

We build lightweight automation systems that:
• detect interested leads instantly
• trigger follow-ups automatically
• keep the pipeline moving

Want me to send a quick breakdown?

Best,
{sender_name}
